welcome.title: Welcome to Fridge Manager
welcome.body: Track what you own, avoid waste, and plan meals smarter.

account.pendingAppleRevocationMessage: Your Pantrio account deletion was accepted, and the server is retrying the Apple disconnection automatically. Because that retry may not finish, you can guarantee disconnection in iOS Settings under Apple Account > Sign-In & Security > Sign in with Apple > Pantrio by choosing Stop Using Sign in with Apple. This does not cancel an App Store subscription.
